body: Usage endpoints (both undocumented, both 429 when polled): Claude GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with Bearer + `anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20`; read limits[] (kind session / weekly_all / weekly_scoped, percent, severity, resets_at, scope.model.display_name), fall back to five_hour / seven_day*; extra_usage passed through (becomes a synthetic 'Extra usage' window when enabled). Codex GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage with Bearer + ChatGPT-Account-Id; rate_limit.{primary,secondary}_window.{used_percent, limit_window_seconds, reset_at}; windows labelled by length (18000 s = 5-hour, 604800 = weekly, 2592000 = 30-day; the free plan has only the 30-day one). First confirmed via the open-source Claude-Usage-Tracker app (2026-09-24).
